bounded_visibility_and_backpressure.principle: No queued state may leak, and producers must receive bounded dispositions.

changed_latency_semantics_disclosed.principle: Shared acknowledgment changes latency semantics and cannot support the old speed claim.

complete_fixed_event_roster.principle: Every fixed event must have a terminal acknowledgment row.

durable_acknowledgment_crash_safety.principle: Acknowledged events must survive exactly once after every crash boundary.

serial_transition_parity.principle: Grouping may share durability but cannot change an event transition.

acknowledgment_contract.acceptance: A valid unique independent event has entered the bounded host queue.
acknowledgment_contract.acknowledgment: Every ordered event is acknowledged only after the shared durable commit.
acknowledgment_contract.dependent_query_rule: A dependent query forces a flush and charges the full flush delay.
acknowledgment_contract.durable_linearization: The group linearizes when directory fsync completes after atomic replacement.
acknowledgment_contract.queueing: Queued events do not mutate or expose controller state.
acknowledgment_contract.visibility: The complete group becomes visible only after durable linearization.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Declare models executable in this invocation; keep historical identities in hashed sidecars.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each criterion records expected, observed, passed, and principle.
field_principles.acknowledgment_contract: Name changed latency semantics and the dependent-query flush rule.
field_principles.commit_protocol_ready_score: One requires durable acknowledgment, order, exactly-once replay, and bounded visibility.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: Record when the real invocation ends.
field_principles.crash_rows: Every crash boundary records issued events, acknowledgments, and recovered state.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic elapsed time and disjoint phase spans.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host orchestration is host; identify real device execution separately.
field_principles.experiment_id: Bind the evidence to the fixed experiment identity.
field_principles.field_principles: Store explanations here; consumer values remain ordinary top-level fields.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: For blocked evidence name the upstream, exact check, observed value, and expected value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_; external absence starts blocked_.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for actual computation, not an invented task label.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use the correct no-LLM class and never pad duration.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted and completed loads and generation from usable answers.
field_principles.model_invoked: Derive from actual calls, including failed or unusable generation.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record actual input hashes, authority separation, resource ownership, and failures.
field_principles.production_default_changed: An opt-in prototype cannot silently change the shipped default.
field_principles.queue_bounds: Include pending events, bytes, backpressure, and timeout dispositions.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze independent-unit seeds before observing results.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, configuration, input manifests, and raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Keep each unit, arm, seed, error, abstention, cost, metric, and censoring state.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260913 and actual UTC start and end times.
field_principles.same_semantics_speed_claim: The changed acknowledgment unit forbids a same-semantics speed claim.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, completed, and censored units and the stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the result and retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.semantic_parity_rows: Grouped transitions must match the serial reference exactly.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Preserve exact input identity, retirement, and quarantine status.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Record when the real invocation starts.
field_principles.status: Use complete or blocked for terminal evidence; keep unfinished work in separate checkpoints.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain command, exit code, timing, and log hash; do not hide failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed class; oracle evidence forbids positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose shared evaluator authority; exact conformance is not learned correctness.
